title: Reanimated: Myths & Legends
description: Currently reanimates 6 mobs, the others are planned for future updates.
body:
A reanimated version of Myths & Legends' mobs. I aimed to give the mobs more fluid animations, while still preserving their personality.

Currently reanimates:
- All possessed armors
- Condemned
- Lampad
- Scorched sentinel

The other mobs will be added in a future update.
